newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia says 3 soldiers died in poll violence.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia says 3 soldiers died in poll violence.

text.p: At least three soldiers were killed in riots which erupted during Indonesia's general election campaign last month, the Jakarta Post reported on Tuesday.

The newspaper said Jakarta military chief Major-General Sutiyoso posthumously promoted the three soldiers by one grade on Monday and quoted him as saying they died during the 27-day campaign which ended on May 23 ahead of polls on May 29.
Authorities say more than 300 people died during the campaign, mostly from traffic accidents, while 124 died in a shopping centre fire during a riot in South Kalimantan province.
The military has previously said that a number of security force members were only injured in the campaign violence.
"The three soldiers had dedicated their lives to safeguarding the campaigns and were beneficial in their duties. We are very proud of them," Sutiyoso said during a ceremony at his headquarters.

He identified the three soldiers as Sergeant Major Margiono from military intelligence, who died after injuries received in a riot in the town of Bekasi near Jakarta, First Private Mansur from a cavalry unit who was injured in a riot in the town of Tangerang and Second Private Supriyanto, a military policeman injured in a riot in East Jakarta.
All three died later in hospital.
